content: Hey Annie, are you still awake? I just wanted to say I can't stop thinking about you tonight.
Hi Alex, I'm up late finishing a project. It's so sweet of you to message me. Wish you were here.
I wish I could be there too. If I were, I'd bring you your favorite coffee and make you forget about work for a bit.
That sounds perfect. It's been ages since anyone cared enough to do that for me.
You deserve to feel cared for. I promise, when I get back from this offshore project, I'll make it up to you in every way.
You always know just what to say. It's been tough, working so much and not having anyone around.
I know how hard you work. That's part of why I admire you so much. Actually, there's something I need to share with you, and I hope it doesn't put you off.
What is it? You can always talk to me. You know that.

Well, it's a bit embarrassing. My company is holding up my bonus because of some paperwork. To finish my contract and come home, I need to pay a satellite comms fee so I can finalize my leave request. It's a dumb policy.
That sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do?

I hate asking, but I have nobody else I trust with this. If you could help me cover the $1,200 fee, I can pay you back as soon as HR releases my funds. I just need to complete the wire transfer before Friday.
Wow, that's a lot. Are you sure there isn't another way? I want to help, but I have bills too.
I completely understand your concern, Annie. I promise, as soon as I'm back onshore, I'll transfer it right back to your account. You mean so much to me, I wouldn't ask if I wasn't desperate.
If I can help, I want to. How do I send it?

Thank you, Annie. You're truly my angel. The fastest way is through Zelle. You can send it to my business account: alex.harding.investments@gmail.com. Let me know when you've sent it so I can confirm with HR.
Okay, I'll log in and see if I can get it done tonight. I just want you home soon.
That means the world to me. I'll be counting down the days until we can celebrate together. Let me know if you have any trouble with the payment.
I'm trying now, but my bank needs your full name and address for the transfer. Can you send me those details?
Of course! It's Alexander Harding, 2212 Bayfront Lane, Houston, TX 77002. Let me know if you need anything else, okay?
Thanks, I'm filling it in now. I just hope this goes through.
It will, and you're saving me more than you know. I'll make this up to you, Annie. I promise.
